record.paper_title: Open problems in the Kontsevich graph construction of Poisson bracket symmetries
record.original_question: Does the evolution equation Ṗ = Q(P) for Poisson structures itself carry a Poisson or Hamiltonian formulation on the jet space of Poisson bi-vector components, meaning that one can write Q(P)=π(χ(P)) for some variational Poisson structure π and variational covector χ, possibly χ=δH/δP for a well-defined Hamiltonian functional?

evidence.quote: Problem 10. Does the evolution P˙ = Q(P) of Poisson structures P obey the above meta-principle implying that this evolution itself ought to be Poisson, Q(P) = π(χ(P)), where π is a variational Poisson structure on the jet space of Poisson bi-vector components and χ is a variational covector (possibly, the variational derivative δH/δP of a well defined Hamiltonian functional, cf. [16, 26]) ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let M be a smooth manifold and let P denote a Poisson bi-vector on M, i.e. a section of Λ²TM satisfying the Jacobi identity [[P,P]] = 0, where [[·,·]] is the Schouten–Nijenhuis bracket. Consider an evolution equation on the space of Poisson bi-vectors of the form

  Ṗ = Q(P),

where Q(P) is a bi-vector built universally from P and its derivatives by a finite linear combination of Kontsevich-type oriented graph cocycles, and where Q(P) is required to preserve the Jacobi identity (i.e. [[P, Q(P)]] = 0 whenever [[P,P]] = 0).

Working on the infinite jet space J^∞ of the components of the Poisson bi-vector P (regarded as unknown fields), let π be a variational Poisson structure on this jet space (i.e. a Hamiltonian differential operator giving rise to a variational Poisson bracket on the corresponding space of local functionals) and let χ = χ(P) be a variational covector (a section of the appropriate horizontal cotangent bundle on J^∞).

Question: Does there exist such a pair (π, χ) so that the flow Ṗ = Q(P) admits the Hamiltonian/Poisson representation

  Q(P) = π( χ(P) ),

and, in particular, can χ be chosen as the variational derivative χ = δH/δP of a well-defined local Hamiltonian functional H of the jet of P?
artifact.category_tag: Kontsevich graph flows on Poisson structures
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not reveal any published resolution of whether Kontsevich graph flows on the space of Poisson structures admit a variational Poisson/Hamiltonian formulation Q(P)=π(χ(P)) on the jet space of bi-vector components. Related literature (e.g. work on tetrahedral flows preserving the Jacobi identity, and variational Poisson cohomology) addresses adjacent questions but does not appear to settle this one. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Do the Kontsevich tetrahedral flows preserve or destroy the space of Poisson structures
status_evidence.snippet: Studies whether Kontsevich graph-derived flows on bi-vectors preserve the Poisson property; does not provide a Hamiltonian formulation for the flow itself.
status_evidence.claim: Closely related work studies the flow Ṗ=Q(P) but does not give it a variational Hamiltonian structure.

status_evidence.title: The variational Poisson cohomology (Kac et al.)
status_evidence.snippet: Develops variational Poisson cohomology and Hamiltonian operators on jet spaces, the framework in which the question is posed.
status_evidence.claim: Provides the variational Poisson framework but does not resolve whether Kontsevich graph flows fit it.
